messages.content: Return only a complete Python program as direct text with real line breaks and indentation. No JSON wrapper or escaped-code string. Use meaningful variables and ordinary arithmetic, comparisons, Boolean and/or/not, and conditional expressions. This program is parsed without executing arbitrary Python and passes the existing source, type, scope, resource and completion checks. No imports, tools, loops, attributes or extra output. A public numeric/string input is a plain assignment with exact evidence comment: variable = literal # sN. Do not enumerate or copy source paragraphs into variables. Derived quantities are expressions. Factual predicates remain unresolved: declare b_ variables by observation(entity=EXACT_ENTITY, entity_source=FACT_SOURCE_ID, predicate=EXACT_RULE_PREDICATE, predicate_source=RULE_SOURCE_ID). Use named arguments to preserve these four different roles. An entity is an actual name from factual text, never an sN source ID. Quotes must be literal substrings of the indicated source. Do not supply their truth values. Never use an observation for a legal conclusion, numeric comparison, threshold, year or date calculation. A partly untranslated legal subexpression uses b_name = residual(RULE_SOURCE_ID, EXACT_PROPER_SUBQUOTE); the containing rule must read it. It stays both true/false, never a guessed answer. A legal output is a no-argument function: decorate with @rule("sN", "sM", otherwise=EXPLICIT_DISABLED_VALUE), then def meaningful_name(): return EXPRESSION. The rule IDs own precisely the full rules actually translated. An additional factual source ID is evidence only and must already occur in an input or observation; the compiler retains it as provenance without creating inputs, truth or rule coverage. Its disabled value must be supplied explicitly with the correct type; it is not inferred. Applicability is a no-argument function with @scope("sN") and return BOOLEAN_EXPRESSION. Every inherited applicability scope is physically enforced on affected rule outputs by the source context. Literal True is allowed as scope only for the supplied structural_title_sources; actual conditions require executable predicates. Never enumerate all paragraphs as True scopes; a scope does not itself translate a rule output. Unused scopes, ordinary calculations and references do not cover untranslated rules. Declare each name once; reference a rule result by its name or a no-argument call. Finish with query = EXPRESSION using guarded rule outputs and the exact native output shape. Do not substitute a native answer literal, an unguarded local result or a fallback. Python lists/dictionaries, min/max and sum(NUMERIC_LIST) are supported. All branches must type check. Exact division uses an integer denominator; monetary results must remain exact. The runtime contract lists actual typed-input constructors, the seven connector operators, their parameter shapes and output projections. Use explicit learned(pattern=...,variant=...,slots=...,columns=...) calls only when an available graph matches current witness/quantity obligations. Copying graph operators is not stored-pattern reuse. All current facts, amounts, relation witnesses and resource metadata need exact source grounding; do not invent them. Partial source remains unresolved; do not invent missing rules to claim completion. Earlier examples teach syntax only; CURRENT has its own entities, years, rules and native result.
